clue.text: Brief message to advertise a club, for example

parts.note: to post a notice is to advertise it publicly
a club is one of the playing cards of that suit

explanation.surface: Someone sends a short note publicising a social club.
explanation.definitionFit: A short greeting written on a stamped picture card is a typically brief piece of correspondence.

clue.text: Look after one fruit or another

indicators.note: after places Look behind the fruit

parts.note: a pome is a fruit such as an apple
lo is an old word for look

explanation.surface: Someone tends one fruit or a different one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' is the definition: having named one fruit, the clue's answer is a second, the grapefruit-like citrus.
explanation.definitionFit: A large citrus related to the grapefruit is a further fruit after the first.

clue.text: Dethrones after revolution, in brief

indicators.note: a revolution turns things over, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Rebels topple monarchs following an uprising, summarised briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after revolution' works on DETHRONES; the surface's revolution topples kings.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cut down or abbreviated is put into briefer form.

clue.text: For example, Queen's supporter captured by King

indicators.note: captured by means held inside the king

parts.note: Old King Cole of the nursery rhyme
a leg supports a table or a body

explanation.surface: A royal backer is taken prisoner by a king.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen's College, Oxford, is the example; 'Queen' and 'King' paint a royal picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Queen's is one of the constituent institutions of a university.

clue.text: School with gormless head going into the red

indicators.note: going into means the head letter goes inside the red

parts.note: ruby is a deep red

indicators.note: head points to the first letter of the word gormless

explanation.surface: A dim pupil's head goes red with embarrassment.
explanation.walkthrough: RUGBY School is a famous English public school, birthplace of the sport.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-known English independent boarding establishment in Warwickshire.

clue.text: A maid of honour's turning back the beds

indicators.note: turning back means the words before it are read from right to left

parts.note: a maid of honour is a small almond-curd tart, so this gives tarts in the plural

explanation.surface: A bridesmaid turns down the beds in the bridal suite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning back' reverses A plus TARTS to give the answer. A maid of honour is a British pastry, a little custard tart, not a bridesmaid here.
explanation.definitionFit: Layers of rock lying one above another are called beds by geologists.

clue.text: Proverbial company collapse, in more than one section

parts.note: the proverb says two's company, three's a crowd
a business that folds collapses

explanation.surface: A notorious firm goes under in multiple divisions.
explanation.definitionFit: Double, with two parts, means having more than one component.

clue.text: A party put 'in embarrassing position

parts.note: a bash is a party

explanation.surface: A celebration leaves someone in an awkward spot.
explanation.definitionFit: To disconcert someone is to make them ashamed or embarrassed.

clue.text: It's shown by characters starting any likeable activity, and keen about it

definitions.text: It's shown by characters starting any likeable activity, and keen about it

indicators.note: characters starting means the opening letters of the following words
about means the wailing word goes round the other piece

parts.note: to keen is to wail or cry in mourning
taken as written

explanation.surface: Eagerness shows in someone who starts any pleasant activity with enthusiasm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters starting' gives ALA; 'keen' is the verb to wail, CRY, which goes about IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Brisk eagerness and readiness is what one shows when keen on an activity.

clue.text: Neat pictures held up in view

indicators.note: in means the reversed pictures sit inside the view

parts.note: sight means view

indicators.note: held up in a down clue means the word is turned upwards

parts.note: art means pictures

explanation.surface: Tidy paintings are raised so they can be seen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held up' reverses ART to TRA in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A drink served neat is undiluted, taken without water or mixer.

clue.text: Continues working secretly at a romantic piece

parts.note: to moonlight on is to keep doing an undeclared second job

explanation.surface: Someone keeps a secret second job at an amorous composition.
explanation.definitionFit: Beethoven's famous piano sonata is a dreamy work from the Romantic era.

clue.text: In which a great number attempt to secure fortune at last

definitions.text: In which a great number attempt to secure fortune at last

parts.note: a lot means a great many

indicators.note: to secure here means to hold something within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a try is an attempt

indicators.note: at last points to the final letter of the word fortune

explanation.surface: Many people try to win a fortune in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to secure' means holding E, the last letter of 'fortune', inside the attempt. Read as a whole, the clue also describes the answer: many people hoping to win riches.
explanation.definitionFit: A draw in which many people buy tickets hoping to win riches by chance is exactly what this is.

clue.text: A different part of flower? Nothing in it

indicators.note: in it says the nothing goes inside the flower part just named

parts.note: the anther is the pollen-bearing part of a stamen
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A botanist asks about a different flower part and finds it empty.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means one more or a separate, alternative one.

clue.text: Make rare gains, initially, as weaker player

parts.note: to underdo meat is to cook it rare

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of the word gains

explanation.surface: A sportsman makes uncommon progress at first, despite being the weaker side.
explanation.definitionFit: The competitor expected to lose is the outsider in the contest.

clue.text: Fixed end of interval, indeed, within which article is needed

definitions.text: Fixed end of interval, indeed, within which article is needed

indicators.note: fixed means repaired or arranged, so these letters are reordered
end of points to the final letter of the word interval

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A set close to a period of time, within which a newspaper piece must be filed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fixed' rearranges L, INDEED and A; the whole clue also describes a journalist's time limit.
explanation.definitionFit: A time limit is a set end to a period within which copy must be delivered.

clue.text: What's outstanding about upstart's presentation?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the debt goes round the other piece

parts.note: a debt is money still outstanding
the start of 'up' is U

explanation.surface: A question about what makes a young upstart's presentation remarkable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upstart' splits as 'up' plus 'start': its start is U, which 'about' puts inside DEBT.
explanation.definitionFit: A first appearance in public, such as a society coming-out, is a presentation.

clue.text: Advocate who had a fit when hunting

annotationWithheld.why: Advocate who had a fit when hunting (9): the definition is Advocate, but no parse of 'who had a fit when hunting' giving BARRISTER was found or confirmed by search
annotationWithheld.clue: Advocate who had a fit when hunting

clue.text: Go out, accompanied by somebody attractive

parts.note: with means accompanied by
a draw is a crowd-pulling attraction

explanation.surface: Someone leaves on the arm of a charming person.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave or retire, as troops do, is to pull back and exit.

clue.text: How I may be reported on the radio in foreign country

definitions.text: How I may be reported on the radio
definitions.meaning: in the radio phonetic alphabet the letter I is spoken as this code word
a nation abroad, here the large country of South Asia

explanation.definitionFit: It is both the radio code word for the ninth letter and the name of a South Asian nation.

clue.text: Slow passages take so long, carrying precious metal

indicators.note: carrying means holding the metal inside

parts.note: adios is Spanish for goodbye, so long
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Leisurely corridors take ages while bearing a costly metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Musical movements played at a slow tempo are slow passages.

clue.text: Some reprehensible character or other in a novel

indicators.note: novel means new, so these letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A wicked figure of some sort appears in a work of fiction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like the book but is the anagram signal on OTHER IN A.
explanation.definitionFit: A protagonist who lacks heroic virtues is a morally dubious central figure.

clue.text: Foreign noble delighted I turned up in house

indicators.note: in means the reversed piece sits inside the house
turned up in a down clue reverses the words before it

parts.note: glad means delighted

explanation.surface: A Spanish aristocrat is thrilled to arrive at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses GLAD plus I to IDALG.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of Spain's lesser nobility is a gentleman of rank abroad.

clue.text: Hint of danger that's besetting part of our army

indicators.note: besetting means surrounding, so the army part goes inside

parts.note: taken as written; the 's is 'is'
RE are the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army

explanation.surface: A warning sign surrounds a unit of the British Army.
explanation.definitionFit: A menace is an indication that harm may come.

clue.text: Sole means of protection

parts.note: read 'sole' not as 'only' but as the underside of a boot, guarded by a large-headed stud

explanation.definitionFit: A heavy-headed nail is driven into boot soles to stop them wearing down.

clue.text: For instance, put in foundation

indicators.note: put in means the example word goes inside the foundation

parts.note: a bed is a foundation layer, as of concrete
as means for instance

explanation.surface: An example is placed into the groundwork.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a whole, the clue also defines the answer: put on a foundation, set on a base.
explanation.definitionFit: Something founded upon a base or grounding has been set on a foundation.

clue.text: A theologian is dividing church? How despicable!

indicators.note: dividing means splitting the church abbreviation apart with the other pieces

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree

explanation.surface: Someone is scandalised that a divinity scholar is splitting a congregation.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaviour like an ungentlemanly cad is contemptible, so the exclamation fits.

clue.text: Tight finish

definitions.meaning: a contest that is tight is near and evenly matched
to end or shut something down

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both narrowly fought and to conclude.

clue.text: One has to be up the spout to play this!

definitions.text: One has to be up the spout to play this!

parts.words: One has to be up the spout to play this!
parts.note: read 'up the spout' literally: the player is facing the barrel of a revolver, and must be crazy to play

explanation.definitionFit: The lethal game with a single bullet in a revolver suits only someone deranged.

clue.text: Point that's extremely general

parts.note: W is west, a compass point
id est, Latin for 'that is', is abbreviated i.e.

explanation.surface: A remark about a point that is very broad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' is the Latin id est, written out in full.
explanation.definitionFit: Most general means broadest or most wide-ranging in scope.

clue.text: Party member runs into whip after protest

indicators.note: after places the whip piece behind the protest

parts.note: a demo is a protest march

indicators.note: into means the runs letter goes inside the whip

parts.note: a cat-o'-nine-tails is a whip, the cat
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A party member hurries into the whip's office after a demonstration.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the US Democratic Party belongs to that political party.
